card.name: Inside split drug and regimen names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long medical words that are split up, mainly the 'oster' in corticosteroids. It also fires on the middle of names like AVOPEF, DOSAGE and FLOT.

modes.label: Corticosteroids
modes.description: The 'oster' piece in cortic-oster-oids, in immune-related adverse reaction text.

modes.label: Other split names
modes.description: Middle pieces of a heading or regimen name split into several parts.
